title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 SVCB RDATA Wire Parser Architecture
purpose: Define the bounded RFC 9461 ServiceMode SVCB RDATA parser boundary for DNS service binding records.
design_summary: `DnsServiceBindingWireRecord` parses RFC 9460 SVCB RDATA for RFC 9461 ServiceMode records: two-octet SvcPriority, uncompressed fully qualified TargetName, and the remaining SvcParams as sorted RFC 9460 key/value pairs. `DnsServiceBindingServiceParameter` provides the generic SVCB key/value decoder without inheriting RFC 9464 provisioning restrictions, so HTTPS SvcParam keys such as address hints remain admissible. The parser decodes registered values needed by the DNS mapping (`alpn`, `port`, and `dohpath`) and then delegates scalar validation to `DnsServiceBindingRecord`. Unknown sorted SvcParams are preserved as deterministic hex-valued HTTPS service-parameter entries for caller inspection.
data_and_state_considerations: The parser is a pure byte-to-value helper. It does not perform DNS resolution, parse complete DNS messages, process Additional-section address records, validate DNSSEC, open encrypted DNS transports, or mutate resolver state.
edge_cases_and_constraints: AliasMode priority zero is rejected because this slice is limited to ServiceMode endpoint-selection values.
Compressed TargetName pointers are rejected; RFC 9460 requires an uncompressed fully qualified TargetName in SVCB RDATA.
SvcParams are parsed through the existing strictly increasing RFC 9460 key/value codec.
`alpn` values must contain complete length-prefixed identifiers, `port` must be exactly two octets, and `dohpath` must decode to an existing RFC 9461-valid relative URI Template.
risks: This slice does not implement AliasMode chain resolution.
This slice does not parse DNS message headers, questions, answers, or Additional-section address records.
Unknown SvcParams are preserved but not interpreted beyond deterministic key/value exposure.

supplemental_sections.heading: Implementation Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: Keeping the SVCB RDATA parser in `Incursa.Quic.Dns` lets resolver or discovery adapters consume DNS wire answers without coupling RFC 9461 scalar selection to QUIC transport runtime, TLS state, or platform resolver installation.
